parameters.content:
## search_evidence
Embed the question with Ollama, search Qdrant with optional taxonomy filters, group chunks by document. Copies with a `canonical` original in the results are dropped.

## get_document
Serve a document only if ingest stored it. Excluded, stub, and invalid documents are never in Qdrant, so they are never served. Full text comes from GitHub.
